a2a.name: A2A · External Agent Collaboration
a2a.description: Agent2Agent protocol: delegate tasks to external agents, or let other agents on your network send tasks to this Ginno.
a2a.field-a2a-enabled-desc: Master switch for outbound delegation and inbound listening
a2a.field-inbound-enabled-desc: Let other agents on the network send tasks to this Ginno (off by default, fail-closed)
a2a.field-bind-mode-desc: loopback: this machine only; lan: local network; custom: interface below
a2a.field-bind-interface-desc: Only used when bind scope is custom (e.g. 192.168.1.10)
a2a.field-enabled-desc: When disabled, no tasks are delegated to this agent
a2a.field-peer-fingerprint-desc: Pinned TLS fingerprint parsed from the address #fp fragment (address-as-credential)
a2a.field-auth-scheme-desc: Choose per the peer's Agent Card declaration
a2a.field-token-desc: Sensitive credential; shown masked after saving
a2a.field-trust-desc: Pinned before dispatch and re-checked at execution; full does NOT grant config write
a2a.field-caps-desc: L0–L3 ladder, constrained by trust level
a2a.field-confirm-mode-desc: Whether each delegation needs your confirmation
a2a.field-allow-local-files-desc: Let the peer read local files via artifacts (default off)
a2a.field-task-timeout-s-desc: Cancel the remote task and mark a local terminal state on timeout
a2a.field-max-concurrent-desc: Upper bound of tasks delegated to this agent at once
a2a.inbound-subtitle: Turning this on generates a capability address — paste it to the peer to connect.
a2a.inbound-master-off: The A2A master switch is off — enable A2A in the Settings tab first.
a2a.inbound-enable-confirm-body: Once enabled, other agents holding the capability address can send tasks to this machine. Binding defaults to loopback (127.0.0.1) only; inbound tasks that trigger sensitive actions always go through human approval and never run automatically.
a2a.inbound-address-secret-hint: This address is equivalent to a password — do not share it publicly.
a2a.inbound-address-empty: The capability address is generated once inbound is enabled.
a2a.inbound-address-not-ready: Inbound is enabled, but the backend has not reported a capability address yet (skeleton stage or listener not ready).
a2a.inbound-copy-failed: Copy failed — select the address and copy it manually.
a2a.inbound-reset-confirm-body: After resetting, every peer must paste the new address again; the old address stops working immediately.
a2a.inbound-reset-done: Address reset — distribute the new address to your peers.
a2a.outbound-subtitle: Each external agent is a separate connector instance; trust boundaries are per agent.
a2a.wizard-step1-hint: Accepts a capability URL (with token and #fp fingerprint), a standard endpoint, or a bare domain; domains get the well-known discovery path automatically.
a2a.wizard-err-token: Invalid capability token: expected 26 base32 characters (possibly truncated or altered).
a2a.wizard-err-fingerprint: Invalid certificate fingerprint: expected 26 base32 characters (possibly truncated or altered).
a2a.wizard-card-failed: No Agent Card published or unreachable — you can enter a name manually and continue.
a2a.wizard-trust-warning: This agent is operated by a third party. Its skill descriptions enter your model context, and delegated content leaves this machine. Make sure you trust this source.
a2a.wizard-token-placeholder: Paste the credential provided by the peer
a2a.wizard-token-hint: The credential is stored locally and only used for requests to this agent.
a2a.wizard-token-skipped: The capability address already carries the credential (address-as-password) — nothing extra to fill in.
a2a.wizard-oauth2-note: OAuth2 browser authorization is P2 and not supported in this version.
a2a.wizard-trust-hint: Read-only by default; dispatch confirmation defaults to asking every time. Adjust later in this instance's Permissions tab.
